findings.text: follow-on: the repository already owns the question "does the manifest predate the current attempt" in _worker_launched_after_manifest, and reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:27 adds a second predicate for the same question keyed on the attempt clock instead of extending that owner, so two clocks now answer it and must be kept in step by hand.

follow-on: the `if alive is False: return False` narrowing contradicts this same function's docstring at line 61, which states the pointer's pid in the resume window is its predecessor's so its death is not this attempt's; read in that window the guard stands down and lets the predecessor's blocked word govern a live resumed attempt, though the window is narrow because the attempt-clock clause must also hold.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 050a6556c; 49dae5a6e adds _manifest_predates_the_current_attempt (line 27), the seven-line manifest-clearing stanza (line 293) and two liveness imports, and 6e08e1332 adds an `if alive is False: return False` narrowing (line 72) and a three-line evidence fragment (line 1).
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names three readings (a blocked manifest predating the attempt reads working with no blocked duty; the same blocked word rewritten after the attempt's start reads blocked; a run with no attempt clock reads as today), and tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py:249,272,292,314,338 asserts exactly those; the gate logs record the importing test files at base (1 failed, 456 passed) and head (1 failed, 463 passed) with the same single failure id.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a manifest written before the run's current attempt began is not read as that attempt's status; reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:27 defines _manifest_predates_the_current_attempt and :293 clears the manifest's word when it fires, so a resumed run is read from its own attempt's liveness.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it reads status complete, names commits 49dae5a6e and 6e08e1332, records the base arm at 1 failed/456 passed and the head arm at 1 failed/463 passed with the same single pre-existing failure, and points at gate-base.log, gate-head.log and negative-control.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read from the dispatch's own fence (prompt.txt:69-72): the declared write paths are reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py, the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/ and a figure directory; the diff touches the first three and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: every added assertion compares a literal ("running", "blocked", None) against the classifier's own output, and negative-control.log:23 shows the first case red under the declared mutation, with five failing ids the head arm does not fail.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py:249 asserts classification equals the literal "running", and the manifest records both arms' own summary lines from gate-base.log and gate-head.log with a zero added-failure delta.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's prose-comment idiom at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:238-248 and introduces no forbidden name, though its seven-line clearing stanza is copied verbatim from :270-288 and the new predicate sits in the classification module while its sibling lives at reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:254.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:293 clears the predating manifest's word, so the first fixture reads running rather than its predecessor's blocked.
justifications.reuse: a search over reckon/crew for a manifest-versus-attempt-age predicate found the existing owner reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:254 _worker_launched_after_manifest; reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:27 answers the same question from a second clock in a second module rather than extending that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, tests/test_a_resumed_run_is_not_read_by_its_old_status.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-resumed-run-is-not-read-by-its-old-status.html) is inside the fence at prompt.txt:69-72 and carries nothing the goal does not imply.
